basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old entrepreneur from Portland, Oregon, diving deep into the world of online reselling. I started off flipping garage sale finds and now run a small online store specializing in vintage electronics and rare collectibles. I'm passionate about music and often listen to Christian hip hop while working. In my downtime, I'm an avid gamer, primarily playing Grand Theft Auto V on PC. My typical online hours are late evenings and early mornings, as I juggle my reseller business and a part-time gig as a barista. I'm in a committed relationship with my partner of 5 years, and we often enjoy exploring local cafes and bagel shops together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in reselling comes from years of hands-on experience, attending online courses, and being an active participant in reselling communities. I learned the ropes through trial and error, and I’m constantly updating my strategies based on market trends I come across in subreddits and Discord groups.
